message.content: {"caption":"Grouped horizontal bar chart comparing three agents’ scores across three benchmark levels and their overall average.","description":"The chart is titled “GAIA Benchmark.” Its legend maps black to Alita, medium gray to manus.ai, and light gray to OpenAI DeepResearch. Four groups are shown vertically: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, and Average. The horizontal axis runs from 0.3 to 0.9 in 0.1 increments, so it does not start at zero; bar-end percentages are printed. A dashed horizontal divider separates Level 3 from Average. Alita leads the other two agents in every group: 88.7% at Level 1, 89.5% at Level 2, 76.9% at Level 3, and 87.3% on Average. Its score rises slightly from Level 1 to Level 2, then falls at Level 3. Manus.ai scores 86.5%, 70.1%, 57.7%, and 73.3%, respectively; OpenAI DeepResearch scores 74.3%, 69.1%, 47.6%, and 67.4%. Both comparison agents score lower at Level 3 than at Levels 1 and 2, and their Average scores are between their Level 2 and Level 3 scores.
